name: Product Hunt
summary: Community for launching and discovering new products.

flows.title: Post a product
steps: Click the Post button in the top right and submit the product's URL to begin.
Enter the name of the product only, with no description or emojis unless they are part of the name.
Write a tagline, a very short description of the product.
Choose the topics that most strongly relate to the product.
Add a thumbnail. A square image is best, 240x240 recommended.
Upload images to the gallery. The recommended size is 1270x760, and the gallery needs two or more images before it is viewable.
Add the makers by their Product Hunt username.
Write the first comment to start the conversation.
Schedule your launch for a future date, or select Create draft if you are not ready to choose a date.
